layers.name: base
layers.doc: Shared primitives: canonical JSON, digests, random streams, input limits, errors, logging, and the clock. Post-#1804 owner: OpenRAE/rae. Keep primitive authority; expose only required consumer types through #1825/#1892.

external.reason: The RFC 8785 canonicalizer, packaged from the reference implementation of the RFC author.
BLAKE3 key derivation and keyed extendable output with a correct seek, for the published random-stream profiles.
Unicode case folding with the result of Python's str.casefold, for the secret-bearing query check of urisafety.
NFKC normalization for the netloc check that mirrors Python's urlsplit.
MIT-licensed RPM version ordering with tilde/caret semantics; exact epochs are compared separately.

layers.name: contract
layers.doc: Bindings and validation of the published contracts, concept authority, vocabularies, and profiles. Post-#1804 owner: OpenRAE/rae, including all normative bindings, schemas, IDs, profiles and validation; runtime consumes released public APIs.

external.reason: Apache-2.0 Draft 2020-12 validation of the authoritative published schemas; the standard library has no JSON Schema validator.
Unicode character names for syntax-only validation of Python-compatible vocabulary metadata expressions; no expression matching or execution.
Comparison of recorded reference results and full structures in tests, as the Google Go style decisions recommend; no product code imports it.

layers.name: sdl
layers.doc: The RAES SDL: source loading, the document model, semantic validation, instantiation, and composition. Post-#1804 owner: OpenRAE/rae, including runtime vocabulary, inventory descriptions, instantiation and authoring.

external.reason: MIT-licensed YAML scanner and ordered syntax tree with token marks; source bounds run before parsing and SDL applies its own Core resolution.

Maintained MIT/Apache-2.0 YAML grammar composer preserves complex and duplicate keys and alias graph identity. Scalar resolution remains SDL-owned; the scanner supplies pre-composition limits and token end marks.
Full locale-neutral Unicode lowercasing, including expansions and final sigma, preserves Python structural-key diagnostics and collision detection.
The Und locale selects Unicode default lowercasing without locale-specific tailoring.
Structured source-value, range and diagnostic comparisons in tests, as required by the Google Go style decisions.
Apache-2.0 PEP 440 parser and specifier evaluator used by Trivy; module admission wraps it with the narrower packaging SpecifierSet grammar and prerelease policy.

layers.name: processor
layers.doc: Compilation, planning, trial compilation, and the analysis services. Post-#1804 owner: OpenRAE/rae, including trial compilation; runtime imports released public processor APIs without semantic copies.

layers.name: backend
layers.doc: The interfaces that the runtime needs from a backend, backend manifests, and the backend test doubles. Post-#1804 owner: OpenRAE/rae for portable interfaces, manifests and stubs; existing external backends retain native realization.

layers.name: runtime
layers.doc: The runtime control plane, its stores, distributed execution, and participant control. Post-#1804 owner: new runtime repository (planning name OpenRAE/rae-runtime; destination approval required). Runtime imports released public rae SDL/processor/contract/backend APIs; rae product modules never import runtime.

layers.name: conformance
layers.doc: Processor and backend conformance checks. Post-#1804 split: pure fixture/processor/contract checks stay OpenRAE/rae; execution-dependent runners belong to runtime. Split the facade without a reverse import.

layers.name: app
layers.doc: Application services that the command line, the MCP server, and the HTTP API share. Post-#1804 split: authoring services stay OpenRAE/rae and never import runtime; live execution services belong to runtime.

layers.name: adapter
layers.doc: Thin adapters for the raes command, the raes-mcp server, and the control-plane HTTP API. Post-#1804 split: authoring commands and MCP stay OpenRAE/rae; runtime commands and HTTP belong to runtime. #1825 owns public command composition.

layers.name: command
layers.doc: The main packages of the raes and raes-mcp binaries. Post-#1804 publishers: runtime alone publishes combined raes, importing public rae authoring command implementations; OpenRAE/rae alone publishes raes-mcp with no runtime dependency.

layers.name: parity
layers.doc: The checker of the Go implementation against the golden corpus that the Python implementation recorded (issue #1778). Migration-only through #1804. Retain historical golden evidence in OpenRAE/rae; consumers use immutable versioned vectors with provenance.

external.reason: Comparison of recorded and actual results in tests, as the Google Go style decisions recommend.

layers.name: tooling
layers.doc: Development tools: the repository analyzers, the architecture check, and CI checks. Existing tooling remains OpenRAE/rae-owned; runtime adapts applicable existing CI/release controls for its own source.

external.reason: Comparison of full structures in tests, as the Google Go style decisions recommend.
The module path of each go.mod for archcheck.
The go/analysis framework, its unitchecker, and its analysistest for the repository analyzers (ADR-121).
AST traversal for the repository analyzers.
Resolution of the called function for the repository analyzers.
The admitted Go package loader provides standard typed API snapshots with explicit build configurations.
Validate planned public module paths with the admitted Go module parser.
